event: Thompson Ridge fire (late May 2013), stand-replacing: every tree killed; flux gap May 2013-Jan 2014; tower rebuilt in the burned stand
comparison_rule: split EC at 2013; post-fire years are not the modelled forest

event: Thompson Ridge fire (May-July 2013) burned the Valles Caldera preserve and destroyed the US-Vcm stand; for the ponderosa tower no burn is reported and the FLUXNET BIF has no disturbance record
comparison_rule: check the 2013 EC year (script 32 --per-year); keep unless a gap or a GPP drop shows the footprint burned

event: FASET: every aspen and birch (>6700 trees, ~35% of canopy LAI) girdled over 39 ha in spring 2008
comparison_rule: split EC at 2008

event: Decade-long spruce beetle outbreak, peak 2008, 85% of forest basal area killed
comparison_rule: split EC around 2008; treat later years as a dead-canopy stand

event: Mountain pine beetle attack on a pure lodgepole pine stand from summer 2006 (five-year disturbance)
comparison_rule: whole record is a disturbed stand; no equilibrium comparison of GPP magnitude

event: Gypsy moth defoliation 2006-2008, complete in 2007
comparison_rule: exclude 2006-2008 from GPP statistics

event: Fen drained for forestry in 1969 (land-use change); partial harvest March 2016
comparison_rule: split EC at 2016; drained peat soil carbon not at equilibrium

event: Commercial shelterwood harvest by International Paper in 2002 (just under 30 % of aboveground biomass removed, LAI and litterfall down about 40 %); reduced carbon uptake lasted about 7 years
in_flux_record: recovery only (EC starts 2003, the year after the harvest)
comparison_rule: flag 2003-2009 as post-harvest recovery and keep them out of GPP statistics; later years usable

event: Intensively managed grassland; grassland restoration (renewal) in 2012
comparison_rule: exclude 2012 (and 2013) from GPP statistics

event: Storm Kyrill windthrow (40 ha) in 2007; oaks planted afterwards; flux record from 2010
comparison_rule: GPP seasonality only; not a reference for mature DBF; not NEE

event: White pine planted 2002 on a sandy agricultural field abandoned three years earlier
comparison_rule: GPP seasonality only; not NEE or soil carbon

event: Douglas-fir harvested 1987, broadcast-burned, replanted 1988
comparison_rule: GPP seasonality only; not NEE

event: Severe fire 1979, salvage-logged, replanted 1990; young ponderosa pine, LAI 0.6-0.8
comparison_rule: GPP seasonality only; not NEE

event: Severe wildfire in late June 2004 burned the black spruce forest; tower started August 2008 on the fire scar, now deciduous trees and shrubs; GPP back to mature black spruce levels about 10 years after the fire
in_flux_record: before record (EC from 2008, 4 years after the fire)
comparison_rule: GPP seasonality only; not NEE

event: Intensively managed loblolly plantation on drained forested wetland, 15-28 years old during the record, ~30-year rotations
comparison_rule: GPP seasonality only; not NEE

event: Managed secondary pure Norway spruce stand planted 1981 with 4-year-old seedlings
comparison_rule: GPP seasonality only; not NEE

event: Aleppo pine afforestation from 1964 on former semi-arid shrubland; soil carbon still accumulating
comparison_rule: GPP yes; NEE and soil carbon not an equilibrium test

event: Scots pine planted 1929 on former heathland
comparison_rule: GPP yes; NEE and soil carbon not an equilibrium test

event: White pine plantation established 1974 on sandy abandoned land
comparison_rule: GPP yes; NEE and soil carbon not an equilibrium test

event: White pine plantation established 1939 on sandy abandoned land
comparison_rule: GPP yes; NEE and soil carbon not an equilibrium test

event: Native prairie restored (planted) on prime farmland of the University of Illinois Energy Farm in 2008, the first EC year; mown and harvested every winter from 2009, no fertiliser or irrigation
in_flux_record: yes (EC starts in the planting year)
comparison_rule: drop 2008-2009 establishment years; GPP yes; NEE and soil carbon not an equilibrium test
